representation.fasta_template_convention: Pinned RDKit MolFromFASTA neutral amino-acid residue templates, with N-terminal NH2 and C-terminal carboxylic-acid OXT/OH termini before conjugate attachment.
representation.hydrogen_representation: Hydrogens are not graph nodes; per-atom RDKit implicit and bracket-hydrogen counts are recorded.

conditional_tricarboxylate_audit.interpretation: A conditional pH 7.4 local B29 tri-carboxylate representation; it does not assign whole-system protonation or total charge.

map 92 NZ cap was removed and its single edge to map 84 was replaced by the LysB29 NZ–map 84 carbamate bond

formula.interpretation: Internal source-graph consistency with the formula reported in the Nature supporting information; not independent experimental confirmation.
